A '''Podracing course''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During a race, the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] wrecked the [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] of [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]]. The [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Death/Legends|died]] during the subsequent crash.
